Spirited afternoon, a toast to the desk crew
It was a good run
Travel Ready for Pets and People

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways kept the day moving with calm check-ins, careful carrier handling, and plenty of clear guidance for everyone heading out with a pet. Passengers got steady help before departure, from crate checks to last-minute reminders, and the welcome team made boarding feel smooth and friendly. On the ramp side, the ground team moved carriers with care between services, keeping each handoff simple and safe.

By the time the final calls came through, the desk had already helped set a reassuring pace for travelers and staff alike. A few familiar names, including Ben Morgan and Maya Kim, came through with easy smiles, while Millie made the rounds like a tiny celebrity. That is the kind of routine that keeps trust high and stress low. Keep the same rhythm, keep the updates clear, and keep every pet comfort-first from curb to cabin.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
